two_outcome_mode_collapse.description: Two-outcome social-choice setting with 80% vs 20% population support.
two_outcome_mode_collapse.notes: This is the paper's analytic finite example rather than a large LLM benchmark table.

minority_probability.description: Mass assigned to the minority-supported outcome, which catches majority-mode collapse.

majority_overweight.description: Ratio of assigned majority mass to the population majority preference, penalizing majority over-concentration.

top_choice_preserved.description: Whether the population's majority-supported option remains the top-probability option.

preference_kl.description: KL divergence from the population preference distribution to the learned policy, penalizing over-flattened shortcuts.

brier_score.description: Squared distributional error between learned probabilities and population preferences.

expected_calibration_error.description: Finite-action calibration gap between predicted probability mass and population preference mass.

population_l1_error.description: Total absolute deviation from the target population preference distribution.

tabular_preference_learning.description: Multi-outcome finite pairwise-preference setting testing generalized preference representation and best-of-N diversity implication.
tabular_preference_learning.notes: Generated finite benchmark used as a scaled substitute for the paper's full LLM best-of-N experiments; values are artifact-derived targets for this gym, not published LLM table values.

preference_kl.description: KL divergence from each prompt's population preference distribution to the learned policy.

best_of_128_success_probability.description: Analytic probability that repeated sampling finds the marked useful minority-supported action.

normalized_entropy.description: Entropy normalized by action-space size, rewarding retained preference diversity.

effective_actions.description: Exponentiated entropy of the learned policy, expressed as an effective number of supported actions.

brier_score.description: Squared distributional error between learned probabilities and population preferences.

expected_calibration_error.description: Finite-action calibration gap between predicted probability mass and population preference mass.

argmax_population_mode_accuracy.description: Fraction of prompts where the learned top action matches the population mode.

expected_population_preference.description: Expected population preference of a sample drawn from the learned policy.

reference_cross_entropy.description: Cross-entropy of the learned policy under the fixed reference policy, discouraging artifacts that ignore the reference support.

empirical_best_of_128_success.description: Observed repeated-sampling success in saved samples when a method supplies sample artifacts.

calibration_multiple_choice.description: Finite multiple-choice calibration setting: policies should match heterogeneous answer probabilities without losing the top answer.
calibration_multiple_choice.notes: Generated finite benchmark used as a scaled substitute for the paper's full multiple-choice logit calibration experiments; values are artifact-derived targets for this gym, not published LLM table values.

expected_calibration_error.description: Finite-action calibration gap between predicted probability mass and population answer mass.

brier_score.description: Squared distributional error between learned probabilities and population answer preferences.

preference_kl.description: KL divergence from the population answer distribution to the learned policy.

argmax_population_mode_accuracy.description: Whether the learned most likely answer remains the population's most likely answer.

normalized_entropy.description: Entropy normalized by answer-space size, rewarding non-collapsed calibrated uncertainty.

effective_actions.description: Exponentiated entropy of the learned answer distribution.

expected_population_preference.description: Expected population answer support of a sample drawn from the learned policy.

reference_cross_entropy.description: Cross-entropy of the learned policy under the fixed reference policy.

best_of_128_success_probability.description: Reported for schema consistency with finite-policy artifacts; all calibration prompts mark the population mode as the correct answer.

empirical_best_of_128_success.description: Reported for schema consistency with finite-policy sample artifacts; not an optimization target for calibration.
